title: 1RB0RE_1RC1RE_1LD1LC_0RB0LC_1RF0RB_---1RA: one round trip is a 4-state automaton on a bit word
text: At each left-end turn the tape of 1RB0RE_1RC1RE_1LD1LC_0RB0LC_1RF0RB_---1RA is a bit word interleaved with 1s. A round trip is one left-to-right pass of a 4-state automaton over that word, plus two or three new bits, and the machine halts exactly when the pass ends in two of the four states. The model reproduces laps 3 to 2,561 of the real run and agrees with the machine on 20,000 random words. The irregular zone is the orbit of this automaton, with prefixes that repeat with periods 2, 4, 8, ..., and the periodic block brings any pass back to a safe state within 10 bits. No halt in 200,000 round trips of the model. Still open: a bound that keeps the zone away from the right end.
